purpose: Test whether cedar's real reordering optimizer consumes fix and depends_on hints emitted by the frozen P5A compiler.
claim_boundary: Plan-level consumption on two synthetic, compiler-generated fixtures and cedar's official profile only. This does not establish semantic correctness, independent generalization, executed-plan equivalence, or performance benefit.

fix_case.input: decode=Admit, crop=semantic Unknown, normalize=Admit; no explicit dependency

pass_rule: All commit/freeze/compiler-hint checks and all four candidate-count/selected-path assertions pass; the constrained dependency plan orders decode before normalize while the hint-removed optimum violates that order.
non_claims: Hint-removed arms are deliberate metadata ablations, not safety baselines.
Candidate-count reduction is not automatically a performance improvement.
The official profile and known synthetic fixtures are calibration, not final evaluation.
